notes: Unlike tpch, these definitions are NOT derivable from the schema. Every one carries at least one business convention the columns do not state: amounts are in cents, test orders are excluded, a status whitelist decides what counts as an order, refunds come off the top. `naive` records what a reader who only has the schema would plausibly write, and the gap between `gold` and `naive` is the whole point of the corpus — both run, both look reasonable, and only one is the number the business means.
conventions: Money columns (amt_*) are in CENTS. Every money definition divides by 100.
is_test = 1 marks internal test orders and is excluded from every business figure.
An order counts once it is paid: ord_st in (2,3,4). 1 = created but never paid, 5 = closed unpaid, 6 = fully refunded.
pay_st: 0 unpaid, 1 paid, 2 partially refunded, 3 fully refunded. Paid means pay_st in (1,2).
One row is one line of an order; an order is ord_id and usually has two lines.
Net figures subtract amt_rfnd. Gross figures do not.

metrics.label: GMV
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_pay) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: Cents, test orders, and unpaid rows — three conventions in one definition. The naive answer is off by a factor of a hundred and includes orders nobody paid for.
metrics.summary: GMV：已支付且非测试单的实付金额之和，单位元；用实付 amt_pay，不用优惠前的 amt_total

metrics.label: Net sales after refunds
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 净销售额：GMV 扣掉退款（amt_rfnd），已支付且非测试单，单位元

metrics.label: Gross merchandise value before discount
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_total) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: amt_total is before discount and coupon; amt_pay is what was actually charged. Both exist, both are money, one is the answer.
metrics.summary: 优惠前商品交易总额：已支付且非测试单的 amt_total 之和，单位元

metrics.label: Paid orders
metrics.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT ord_id) FILTER (WHERE ord_st IN (2,3,4) AND is_test = 0) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: A row is a line, not an order, and half the statuses never became a sale.
metrics.summary: 有效订单数：状态为已付、已发货、已完成且非测试单的订单，按 ord_id 去重

metrics.label: Paid order lines
metrics.gold: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE ord_st IN (2,3,4) AND is_test = 0) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 有效商品行数：有效订单且非测试单的明细行数

metrics.label: Buyers who paid
metrics.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT buyer_id) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: Every buyer in this corpus paid at least once, so the filter changes nothing here — the trap is forgetting DISTINCT, which turns 5000 buyers into 60000 rows.
metrics.summary: 付款买家数：已支付且非测试单，按 buyer_id 去重

metrics.label: First-time buyers
metrics.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT buyer_id) FILTER (WHERE is_1st = 1 AND pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.naive: SELECT count(DISTINCT buyer_id) FILTER (WHERE is_1st = 1) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 首单买家数：首单标记为 1 且已支付且非测试单，按 buyer_id 去重

metrics.label: Average order value
metrics.gold: SELECT round((sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0) / count(DISTINCT ord_id) FILTER (WHERE ord_st IN (2,3,4) AND is_test = 0), 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: Per order, not per line — the naive average is per row and lands about half the truth.
metrics.summary: 客单价：净销售额除以有效订单数，单位元

metrics.label: Units sold net of returns
metrics.gold: SELECT sum(qty - qty_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 净销量：已支付且非测试单的件数减去退货件数

metrics.label: Refunded amount
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 退款总金额：非测试单的退款金额之和，单位元

metrics.label: Refund rate over paid orders, percent
metrics.gold: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT ord_id) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (2,3) AND is_test = 0) / count(DISTINCT ord_id) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2,3) AND is_test = 0), 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.naive: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(flg_r) / count(*), 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 退款率：发生过退款的订单数除以付过钱的订单数，按 ord_id 去重、排除测试单，百分比

metrics.label: Gross profit
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd - amt_cost) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 毛利：已支付且非测试单的实付减退款减成本之和，单位元

metrics.label: Gross margin percent
metrics.gold: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd - amt_cost) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0), 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 毛利率：毛利除以净销售额，百分比

metrics.label: Freight collected
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_frght) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 运费收入：已支付且非测试单的运费之和，单位元

metrics.label: Total discount given
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_disc + amt_cpn) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: Two columns make up a discount: the promotion and the coupon. Summing one is a plausible, wrong answer.
metrics.summary: 优惠总额：已支付且非测试单的活动优惠加优惠券之和，单位元

metrics.label: GMV from the app channel
metrics.gold: SELECT round(sum(amt_pay) FILTER (WHERE chnl = 1 AND pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.naive: SELECT round(sum(amt_pay) FILTER (WHERE chnl = 1) / 100.0, 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: APP 渠道 GMV：渠道为 APP 的 GMV，单位元

metrics.label: Average price per unit sold
metrics.gold: SELECT round((sum(amt_pay - amt_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0) / 100.0) / sum(qty - qty_rfnd) FILTER (WHERE pay_st IN (1,2) AND is_test = 0), 2) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.summary: 平均件单价：净销售额除以净销量，单位元

metrics.label: Internal test orders
metrics.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT ord_id) FILTER (WHERE is_test = 1) FROM dw.dwd_ord_dtl
metrics.note: The one question where is_test is the subject rather than a filter. It exists so the corpus is not only about excluding it.
metrics.summary: 内部测试订单数：测试标记为 1 的订单，按 ord_id 去重

dimensions.from: order time — the other time axis besides stat_dt
shop, read from the dimension table instead of the flattened column

traps.why: integer key; sums cleanly and means nothing
integer key; count(distinct) is a metric, sum is not
always 1; a metric on it counts rows by accident, a dimension on it has one group
abandoned column, all NULL since the migration — a metric on it is silently empty
loyalty points, not money; summing it into a revenue figure mixes units
free text typed by support; one group per row
when the ETL ran, not when anything happened — a time axis built on it is meaningless
